summary: Iter 56 – tested Backtester + Optimizer Pause/Resume (backend & UI), ATR-Trailing config panel, AI-Playbook cache, localworker version. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed incl. real backtest & optimizer runs with pause -> paused=true (status stays 'running', phase begins with '⏸ Pausiert'), progress freeze during pause, resume -> paused=false. AI-Playbook 2nd call cached (<2s). localworker required_version = '1.10.0'. Unknown-job pause/resume returns 404, without token returns 401. Frontend: Backtester config panel exposes bt-cfg-trail-<id> (Aus/An) and bt-cfg-trailmult-<id> which hides when 'Aus' selected. bt-pause -> click -> bt-resume + bt-pausing-hint (during data-load phase, paused_total_s=0 so bt-paused-tag only appears once sim loop reaches checkpoint); bt-resume click -> bt-pause returns; toast 'Lauf wird fortgesetzt' shown. Optimizer panel renders full opt-* testid tree; opt-pause -> opt-resume + opt-pausing-hint; resume returns opt-pause.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.js getToken() requires BOTH 'admin_token' AND 'admin_token_ts' (1-day TTL); tests that seed only 'admin_token' silently lose auth and hit 401 on /api/backtest/pause. Consider tolerating missing ts or logging a console.warn to speed diagnosis.

Backtester.js togglePause() shows toast on error but does not surface the specific 'Admin-Login erforderlich' 401 to the user; a toast.error(d.detail) is already there — but the pause button in the UI still visually says 'Pausieren'. Consider disabling pause when isAdmin()===false to avoid confusing 401 noise for non-admins.

AI Panel Verlauf (AIEquityPanel) is only reachable via strategy selection ai_trader + Edit-Params. Not directly openable from header — hard to deep-link/test. Consider a testid on a direct opener (e.g. header shortcut) if this is a common flow.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral backtest job (scalping_4_rules, 4-6 crypto, 60-730d, 1m) and optimizer job (params, scalping_4_rules, BTC/ETH, 30d, 5m, 20 iters) started & reset during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend token needs BOTH localStorage keys admin_token + admin_token_ts (Date.now() ms) — otherwise auth.js getToken() returns null and Pause/Resume POST hits 401. To exercise UI pause on Cloud backtests, start a large job (many coins + 730d + timeframe 1m) — sim is instant with cache so pause is only observable during data-load phase, where paused=false but pause=true (bt-pausing-hint visible, bt-paused-tag not yet). AI panel Verlauf tab reached only via ai_trader strategy + edit-params — skipped in this iteration; the underlying /api/ai/playbook maturity payload is covered by backend test.
rca of the issue: Initial frontend test showed bt-pause click did not flip to bt-resume. Network capture revealed POST /api/backtest/pause/{id} -> 401 'Admin-Login erforderlich'. RCA: auth.js getToken() invalidates the token when admin_token_ts is missing/older than 24h. My initial seeding wrote only admin_token. Fix in test: also localStorage.setItem('admin_token_ts', Date.now()). After that, UI pause/resume works end-to-end for both Backtester and Optimizer.
